Latin word

alō

alō, alere, aluī, altum (alitum)

verb, third conjugation

feed, foster (a talent); nourish, feed and bring up; nourish, foster; feed, keep; nourish, feed, raise

In this lexicon

    also used · classical · Cic. Cael. 45: ingenium industriā alitur (Lewis & Short); Cic. Off. 1.105: hominis autem mēns discendō alitur et cōgitandō

  • feed

    also used · classical · Tac. Germ. 20.1: sua quemque māter ūberibus alit

  • promote

    also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 1.4: honōs alit artēs

  • provide for

    also used · classical · Liv. 21.33.11: per trīduum exercitum aluit

  • rear

    also used · classical · Plaut. Rud. 3.4.36 (Lewis & Short, s.v. ēducō): Athēnīs nātus altusque ēducātusque Atticīs
